name: People in city homeless shelters
definition: Average number of people sleeping in the city Department of Homeless Services shelter system each night, calendar-year average of the DHS Daily Report.

latest_extra.note: Single day, DHS Daily Report. 2026 average to date: 84049 (317 daily reports).

source.name: NYC Department of Homeless Services, DHS Daily Report, NYC Open Data k46n-sa2m (March 2021 on) and dwrg-kzni (historical, to February 2021)

method: Annual value = mean of total_individuals_in_shelter over every daily report dated in that calendar year, pooling the historical dataset (through Feb. 28, 2021) and the current one (from Mar. 1, 2021). Daily reports per year: 2014: 350, 2015: 353, 2016: 362, 2017: 343, 2018: 363, 2019: 364, 2020: 366, 2021: 365, 2022: 365, 2023: 365, 2024: 366, 2025: 365. Days with no published report are simply absent from the average.
caveats: Covers only the Department of Homeless Services shelter system; the dataset describes itself as the daily number of families and individuals residing in the DHS shelter system and does not list other systems.

Not included: HRA domestic-violence shelters, Department of Youth and Community Development youth shelters, HPD emergency housing, and the emergency asylum-seeker sites (HERRCs) run outside DHS. Asylum seekers placed in DHS shelters are included.
No peer comparison: shelter systems and right-to-shelter rules differ too much between cities.
dataset_description:
This dataset includes the daily number of families and individuals residing in the Department of Homeless Services (DHS) shelter system and the daily number of families applying to the DHS shelter system.

This dataset includes data starting from 01/03/2021. For older records, please refer to https://data.cityofnewyork.us/d/dwrg-kzni
